tests.name: Malformed input matrix
tests.description: Try null, A@, @1, a@2, A@+2, A@1000, A@1@2, A @2 and A@2 followed by a space.
tests.expected: Every input is rejected; none is silently corrected.

reasoning: Keeping trailing empty fields with split("@", -1) distinguishes a missing quantity. Exactly two fields rejects extra separators.
After checking 1–3 ASCII digits, Integer.parseInt cannot overflow and yields a value from 0 through 999. Leading zeros do not change the base.
